entities.summary: Liana-Gabriela Ungur is a former professional tennis player from Romania. On 13 December 2010, she reached her highest singles ranking of 157 by the Women's Tennis Association (WTA). Liana Ungur was a athletes & competitors from Socialist Republic of Romania (b. 1985-01-02, Socialist Republic of Romania). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
